notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); identity on fund balance reconciles (1,968,056 - 22,500 prior period adjustment + 3,429,698 - 3,190,108 + 3,195,146 - 2,288,072 = 3,092,220). Business-type from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p6) Total column; receipts total = operating revenues + interest income (computed); disbursements total 2,234,742 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 2,098,261 + interest 125,043 + debt issuance 11,438. Business-type roll-forward 3,669,792 + 3,356,409 - 2,234,742 - 907,074 = 3,884,385. ending_cash = cash + county treasurer from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3; restricted cash 1,035,275 excluded). Detail: the budget schedule (pp8-9) is a combined all-funds function-level schedule and is not used (as FY2023). Revenue detail from the governmental funds statement fund columns (p4) and the non-major combining schedule (p10); spending detail from the Schedule of Expenses (pp11-12, object by department/fund), with the statement's General Fund debt service 5,657 and capital outlay columns (General 7,803 no function printed; Street 923,052; Park 628,230) which the Schedule of Expenses does not cover (no detail_totals for those statement lines). Building Foundation fund has no activity. Business-type detail from the proprietary statement fund columns (p6); interest income/expense and debt issuance are nonoperating, outside the printed operating totals. Governmental funds balance sheet (p3) prints total assets 3,685,679 vs total liabilities, deferred inflows and fund balances 3,685,678 (rounding; not used for balance_sheet). Read pages 1-12 of 12
